visual_action: President Joe Biden speaks at a podium outdoors in front of the White House. To his left, two other men stand by a table with a large white turkey on it. One of the men occasionally pets the turkey. An audience is visible in the foreground. The setting is decorated for Thanksgiving.

cast.name: Joe Biden

cast.name: Peach

cast.name: Blossom
cast.evidence: Biden explicitly states, "I hereby pardon Peach and Blossom." The on-screen text also says, "President Biden pardons Peach and Blossom."

on_screen_text.text: President Biden pardons Peach and Blossom 🦃

STAYING NICE, LISTENING TO THEIR FAVORITE MUSIC, WHICH APPARENTLY INCLUDES THE SONG LIVING ON A PRAYER. WELL FELLAS, YOUR PRAYER IS GOING TO BE ANSWERED TODAY. BASED ON YOUR TEMPERAMENT AND COMMITMENT TO BEING PRODUCTIVE MEMBERS OF SOCIETY, I HEREBY PARDON PEACH AND BLOSSOM.

spoken_summary: President Biden gives a speech for the annual turkey pardon. He makes a joke that the turkeys' favorite music is the song "Living on a Prayer," and says, "Well, fellas, your prayer is going to be answered today." He then formally pardons the two turkeys, named Peach and Blossom, based on their good temperament.
audio_music: The audio consists of President Biden's voice speaking, followed by the sound of an audience applauding and cheering. There is no musical score.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, continuous, static shot of the event with no cuts or edits.
central_claim: President Biden pardoned the national Thanksgiving turkeys, Peach and Blossom, continuing the annual presidential tradition.
intended_effect: To portray President Biden in a positive and traditional presidential role and to share a lighthearted, feel-good moment with the public.
